title: geranium inodorum
intro: Geranium inodorum, commonly known as the West Indian geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the geranium genus. This plant is known for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Geranium inodorum include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
